scheduleIntro: Rock Steady Boxing meets Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. Aqua-Box Fitness meets on seasonal Tuesday and Thursday times.
boxingBody: Non-contact boxing-inspired fitness classes that dramatically improve balance, strength, aerobic activity, mobility, and overall function.
aquaBody: This aquatic fitness class is designed to improve mobility and balance in a safe, low-impact environment. The natural resistance and buoyancy of the water create an ideal setting for larger, more controlled movements with minimal joint stress. Participants can build strength, reduce stiffness, and enhance balance, all while feeling supported and confident, without the fear of falling.
aquaResume: AQUA BOX FITNESS will resume class in the spring 2027
anniversary: Everyone in the program is fighting the same opponent, Parkinson's disease
